harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «جنات» is the second object; the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «يحلَّون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أساور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «أساور» [Translator's note: so in the source]; «لؤلؤا» is a noun conjoined to the position of «من أساور»; the clause «ولباسهم حرير» is conjoined to the clause «يحلون»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl of «لباسهم».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من القول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطيب».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «ويصدون» is conjoined to the clause «كفروا»; «والمسجد» is conjoined to «سبيل»; the relative noun is a second naʿt (adjective); and the preposition and its genitive noun «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. «سواء» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الناس»; «العاكف» is the fāʿil (agent) of «سواء»; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «العاكف»; «والباد» is conjoined to «العاكف», nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ. His saying «ومَن»: the wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the object of «يُرد» is omitted, i.e.: تعدِّيًا (a transgression). The preposition and its genitive noun «بإلحاد» is attached to a ḥāl of the object, i.e.: accompanied by deviation; the preposition and its genitive noun «بظلم» is a badal (substitute) of «بإلحاد».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His saying «وإذ بوَّأنا»: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) «اذكر» (remember); and a past verb that includes the meaning of «بَيَّنَّا» (We made clear). The clause «وإذ بوأنا» is resumptive, and the clause «بوأنا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مكان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya); «لا» is prohibitive; and the clause «لا تشرك» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وأذِّن» is conjoined to the clause «طهِّر», and the clause «يأتوك» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition. «رجالا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw; the preposition and its genitive noun «وعلى كل ضامر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl, i.e.: on foot and being on every…; the clause «يأتين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كل ضامر».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليشهدوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَأْتُوكَ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «لهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «منافع»; the preposition and its genitive noun «على ما رزقهم» is attached to «يذكروا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من بهيمة» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun; the clause «فكلوا منها» is resumptive; «الفقير» is a naʿt of the object.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The lām in «ليقضوا» is the lām of command, which puts the verb in the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «ذلك»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The clause «ومن يعظم» is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يعظِّم» is its khabar. The preposition and its genitive noun and the adverb are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «وأُحِلَّت» is resumptive; «إلا ما يتلى»: a relative noun, excepted. The clause «فاجتنبوا» is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الأوثان» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرجس».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «حنفاء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in «اجتنبوا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حنفاء»; «غير» is a second ḥāl; the preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to «مشركين». The clause «ومن يشرك بالله» is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); «كأنما» is a restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained one (makfūfa); the clause «فكأنما خرَّ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فتخطفه» is conjoined to the clause «خَرَّ», and the clause «أو تهوي» is conjoined to the clause «تخطفه».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «ذلك»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ; the clause «يعظِّم» is the khabar; and the clause «فإنها من تقوى» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached; the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى أجل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «منافع»; the clause «ثم محلُّها إلى البيت» is conjoined to the resumptive one, «لكم فيها منافع».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: His saying «ولكل»: the wāw is resumptive, the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «منسكًا» is the first object. The interpreted maṣdar «ليذكروا» is genitive, attached to «جعلنا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من بهيمة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». The clause «فإلهكم إله» is resumptive; the clause «فله أسلموا» is conjoined to the clause «إلهكم إله واحد»; and the clause «وَبَشِّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المخبتين»; «إذا» is a conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, and the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. His saying «والصابرين»: a noun conjoined to {الْمُخْبِتِينَ}, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «الصابرين». «والمقيمي»: a noun conjoined to «الصابرين», and «الصلاة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the muḍāf may take al- because the annexation is verbal (lafẓiyya) and the muḍāf is a plural. The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to the verb «ينفقون», and the clause «ينفقون» is conjoined to the conditional clause, which is the ṣila of «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: His saying «والبُدن»: the wāw is resumptive, and «البُدن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; the implied (muqaddar) clause is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition and its genitive noun «من شعائر» is attached to the second object of jaʿala; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; the clause «لكم فيها خير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «جعلناها». The clause «فاذكروا» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا البدن»; «صوافَّ» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ. His saying «فإذا وجبت»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the conditional clause is conjoined to the implied conditional clause «إن نحرتموها» (if you slaughter them); the clause «وجبت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: سخَّرناها تسخيرًا مثل ذلك التسخير (We subjected them a subjecting like that subjecting). The clause «سخَّرناها» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «لحومها» is the fāʿil (agent) placed later; the clause «ولكن يناله» is conjoined to the clause «لن ينال»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «التقوى». «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: سَخَّرها الله تسخيرًا مثل ذلك التسخير (Allah subjected them a subjecting like that subjecting). The clause «سخَّرها» is resumptive; the genitive maṣdar «لتكبروا» is attached to «سخرها»; «ما» in His saying «ما هداكم» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the genitive maṣdar is attached to «تكبِّروا»; the clause «وبَشِّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause «إن الله لا يحب» is resumptive; «كفور» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خوَّان».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «للذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the maṣdar «بأنهم ظلموا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أذن». The clause «وإن الله ... لقدير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «على نصرهم» is attached to «قدير»; and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) is in the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «الذين» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هم (they). The preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw; «إلا» is for exception; the interpreted maṣdar «أن يقولوا» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). The conditional clause is resumptive: «لولا» is a particle of impossibility because of existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «دَفْع» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing); «بعضهم» is a badal (substitute) of «الناس»; the preposition and its genitive noun «ببعض» is attached to a ḥāl of «الناس»; the clause «لهدِّمت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «يذكر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مساجد»; His saying «كثيرًا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «ولينصرنَّ» is the response to an oath, and the oath with its response is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The relative noun is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هم الذين» (they are those who); the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause «ولله عاقبة الأمور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: His saying «وقوم»: a noun conjoined to the preceding {قَوْمُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «وأصحاب» is a noun conjoined to {قَوْمُ}. The clause «فأمليت» is conjoined to the clause {وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ}. His saying «فكيف»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna; «نكير» is the noun of kāna, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ; and the clause «فكيف كان نكير» is conjoined to the clause «ثم أخذتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: His saying «فكأين»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «كأين» is an allusive noun for number (ism kināya ʿan ʿadad), mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين»; the clause «أهلكناها» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأين»; the clause «وهي ظالمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أهلكناها»; and the clause «فهي خاوية» is conjoined to the clause «أهلكناها». His saying «وبئر»: a noun conjoined to «قرية».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His saying «أفلم يسيروا»: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive. The fāʾ in «فتكون» is causative (sababiyya), and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the accusative; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be a travelling, and then a having of hearts. The clause «يسمعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آذان»; the clause «فإنها لا تعمى» is resumptive; the clause «ولكن تعمى» is conjoined to the clause «لا تعمى الأبصار»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الصدور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «ويستعجلونك» is resumptive; the clause «ولن يخلف» is conjoined to the resumptive one; the clause «وإن يومًا ...» is resumptive; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «يومًا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: His saying «وكأين»: the wāw is resumptive, and an allusive noun for number (ism kināya ʿan ʿadad), mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين»; the clause «أمليت» is the khabar (predicate); the clause «وهي ظالمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun hāʾ in «لها»; the clause «أخذتها» is conjoined to the clause «أمليت»; and the clause «وإليَّ المصير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause «إنما أنا نذير» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; «مبين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فالذين آمنوا ...» is conjoined to the clause (إِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ), and the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «والذين سعوا ...» is conjoined to the clause «الذين آمنوا ...». «معاجزين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «سعوا», and the clause «أولئك أصحاب الجحيم» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين سعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وما أرسلنا» is resumptive; «رسول» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the conditional clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «نبي»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «والله عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar «ليجعل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يُحْكِمُ}; «فتنة» is the second object of «يجعل»; the clause «في قلوبهم مرض» is the ṣila (relative clause); «القاسية» is a noun conjoined to «الذين», and «قلوبهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «القاسية»; the clause «وإن الظالمين لفي شقاق» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: His saying «وليعلم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to. The maṣdar «أنه الحق» stands in place of the two objects of yaʿlamu; the preposition and its genitive noun «من ربك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الحق». His saying «فيؤمنوا»: a verb conjoined to «يعلم». The clause «وإن الله لهاد» is resumptive; «هاد» is the khabar (predicate), nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى صراط» is attached to «هاد».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «ولا يزال» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «في مرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition and its genitive noun «منه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «مرية». The maṣdar «حتى تأتيهم» is genitive by «حتى», attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which «في مرية» is attached; «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «يوم»: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being established" (istiqrār) attached to the khabar (predicate); «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted clause. The preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to the khabar; the clause «يحكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the name of Majesty; and the relative clause is conjoined to the clause «يحكم».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ «أولئك» [Translator's note: so in the source], and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The fāʾ in «فأولئك» is redundant (zāʾida), likening the relative noun to a condition, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: (والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative clause is conjoined to the preceding relative clause; «رزقًا» is the second object; the clause «ليرزقنَّهم» is the answer to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «والذين»; the clause «وإن الله لهو خير الرازقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «ليدخلَنَّهم» is a badal (substitute) of the clause {لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ}; «مُدْخلا» is the second object; the clause «يرضونه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مدخلا»; the clause «وإن الله لعليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «ذلك» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The wāw in «ومَن» is resumptive; «مَن» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «عاقب» is a khabar; the clause «لينصرنَّه» is the answer to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «مَن».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the second maṣdar, «وأن الله سميع», is conjoined to the first maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). «ما» is a relative noun, the noun of «أن»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ and «الباطل» its khabar; the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first. «هو» is a pronoun of separation, and «الكبير» is a second khabar; the maṣdar «وأن الله هو العلي» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; the clause «فتصبح» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل»; the clause «إن الله لطيف» is resumptive, and «خبير» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «له ما في السماوات» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the clause «لهو الغني» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; «الحميد» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: (ألم تر أن الله سخر لكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); the clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الفلك»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بأمره» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تجري», i.e.: being accompanied. The maṣdar «أن تقع» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذنه» is attached to a ḥāl of the agent of «تقع», i.e.: accompanied by His permission.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إن الإنسان لكفور».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «منسكا» is the first object; the clause «جعلنا» is resumptive; the clause «هم ناسكوه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «منسكا». His saying «فلا ينازعنك»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فلا ينازعنك» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا»; the dropped wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأمر» is attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «وإن جادلوك» is conjoined to the clause «لا ينازعُنَّك»; «ما» in His saying «بما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: (الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two adverbs are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: (ألم تعلم أن الله يعلم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of ʿalima; the preposition and its genitive noun «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition and its genitive noun «على الله» is attached to «يسير».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His saying «وما ليس»: the relative noun is conjoined to the preceding relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to a ḥāl of «عِلْم», and «عِلْم» is the noun of laysa. The clause «وما للظالمين من نصير» is resumptive; «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala); «نصير» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَيَعْبُدُونَ}. «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آياتنا»; the clause «تعرف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «يكادون» is a ḥāl of the relative noun, and the ḥāl may come from the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) here because the muḍāf is a part of the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «يسطون» is the khabar (predicate) of yakādu. The clause «قل» is resumptive, and the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: أأخاطبكم (shall I address you?), and the clause «أفأنبئكم» is conjoined to the implied object of the speech. «النار» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ in «وعدها» is the second object, and the relative noun is the first object; the clause «النار وعدَها» is explicative of «الشر», and the clause «وعدها» is the khabar of «النار». The clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: the Fire.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «ضرب» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «فاستمعِوا» is conjoined to the clause «ضُرِبَ مَثل». The preposition and its genitive noun «مِن دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied (muqaddar) object, i.e.: you call upon them, they being other than Allah. The clause «لن يخلقوا» is the khabar (predicate). The wāw in «ولو» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause «ولو اجتمعوا له» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «يخلقوا». This wāw conjoins to an implied ḥāl, i.e.: they will not create a fly in any state, even in the state of gathering together; this is for exhausting all states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: they will not create. «شيئًا» is the second object; the clause «وإن يسلبهم» is conjoined to the clause «إن الذين»; and the clause «ضعف الطالب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «ما قدروا» is resumptive; «حق» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصطفي», and the preposition and its genitive noun «ومن الناس» is conjoined to the preposition and its genitive noun «من الملائكة» and is attached to what that is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «يعلم» is a third khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بين» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ترجع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), and the clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «حق» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «هو اجتباكم» is resumptive, and the clause «وما جعل» is conjoined to the clause «هو اجتباكم». «حرج» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition and its genitive noun «في الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» is attached to the second object. «ملة» is the mafʿūl bihi of an implied (muqaddar) «أعني» (I mean), and «إبراهيم» is a badal (substitute) of «أبيكم». The clause «هو سمَّاكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم», and «سمَّى» is transitive to two objects: the kāf and «المسلمين». The preposition and its genitive noun «من قبل» is attached to the verb, and it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation. His saying «وفي هذا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «سمَّاكم»; the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and an abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to «سمَّاكم». The preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» is attached to «شهيدا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «على الناس» is attached to «شهداء». The clause «فأقيموا» is resumptive; the clause «هو مولاكم» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause «فنعم المولى» is resumptive: a past verb of praise and its fāʿil (agent), and the one specified (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e.: Allah.

mekki-muskil:1-1.t: His saying, the Exalted, {يَا أَيهَا النَّاس}: أيّ is a singular vocative (nidāʾ mufrad), and هَا is for drawing attention (tanbīh). According to Sībawayh nothing but the nominative is permitted in النَّاس, and it is a naʿt (adjective) of the singular [vocative], because it is indispensable and it is the one addressed in meaning. Al-Māzinī permitted the accusative in it according to the position of أيّ, because the one addressed is a direct object in meaning. It [أيّ] has ḍamma only because it is indeclinable (mabnī), and it was made indeclinable only because it occurs in the position of the one spoken to, and the one spoken to is never an overt noun, only a pronoun, a kāf or a tāʾ. The proof that the one addressed is spoken to is that if you said "By Allah, I will not speak to Zayd" and then said "O Zayd!", you would break your oath, because it is speaking to him. So since it occurs in the position of the pronoun, it was made indeclinable, just as the pronoun is always indeclinable. But in its origin it is fully declinable, so it was made indeclinable on a vowel, and ḍamma was chosen for it because of its strength; and it is said: because of its resemblance to قبل and بعد. There are other views on the reason for its ḍamma besides these, whose mention would be lengthy.

mekki-muskil:10-10.t: His saying {وَأَن الله}: أَن is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to بِمَا. It is also said that أَن is in the position of the nominative in the meaning "and the matter is that Allah…" (وَالْأَمر أَن الله). The kasra [إنّ] as a new beginning (istiʾnāf) is good.

mekki-muskil:13-13.t: His saying {يَدْعُو لمن ضره أقرب من نَفعه}: al-Kisāʾī said: the lām is out of its place, and مَن is in the position of the accusative by يدعو; the implied form is "he calls upon one whose harm is surely nearer than his benefit" (يَدْعُو من لضره أقرب من نَفعه), i.e. he calls upon a god whose harm is surely nearer than its benefit. Al-Mubarrad said: there is an omitted object in the speech, and the lām is in its place; مَن is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), ضره is a mubtadaʾ, أقرب its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, and {لبئس الْمولى} is the khabar of مَن; its implied form is "he calls upon a god; surely the one whose harm is nearer than his benefit — what an evil patron!" (يَدْعُو إِلَهًا لمن ضره أقرب من نَفعه لبئس الْمولى). Al-Akhfash said: يدعو has the meaning of يقول ("says"), and مَن is a mubtadaʾ, ضره a second mubtadaʾ, أقرب its khabar, and the clause is the ṣila of مَن, and the khabar of مَن is omitted, its implied form being "he says: the one whose harm is nearer than his benefit is his god" (يَقُول لمن ضره أقرب من نَفعه إلهه). We have explained this question in a separate book, because there is room for consideration in it and objections to these views, and there are other views on it besides these. It is a difficult (mushkil) question on which much can be said, and for that reason disagreement about it is abundant.

mekki-muskil:17-17.t: His saying {إِن الَّذين آمنُوا وَالَّذين هادوا}: the khabar (predicate) of إن is His saying {إِن الله يفصل}. The Basrans permitted إن زيدا إنه منطلق ("Zayd — he is departing"), just as إن زيدا هو منطلق is permitted. Al-Farrāʾ prohibited it, but permitted it in the verse because it contains the meaning of requital (jazāʾ), so he took the khabar according to the meaning.

mekki-muskil:18-18.t: His saying {وَكثير حق عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَاب}: كثير is nominative, conjoined to مَن in His saying {يسْجد لَهُ من}. That is permissible because prostration is humbling oneself and submitting; so the unbelievers upon whom the punishment has become due are humbled under the decree of Allah and His disposal, and they submit to what was foreordained concerning them in Allah's knowledge, not departing from what was foreordained concerning them in Allah's knowledge. It is also said that كثير is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it is the khabar (predicate). The accusative is permissible, as He said {والظالمين أعد لَهُم عذَابا أَلِيمًا}, by an implied verb, as though He said "and He humiliated many upon whom the punishment became due" or "and He created many upon whom the punishment became due", and the like of such implied forms which the meaning indicates. The nominative was preferred in it according to al-Kisāʾī only because it is taken according to the meaning of the verb, since its meaning is "and many refused to prostrate".

mekki-muskil:20-20.t: His saying {يصهر بِهِ مَا فِي بطونهم}: مَا is in the position of the nominative by يصهر (as nāʾib fāʿil), and {والجلود} is conjoined to {مَا}; the meaning is "by it what is in their bellies is melted, and by it their skins are melted". The hāʾ in {بِهِ} refers back to {الْحَمِيم}.

mekki-muskil:25-25.t:
His saying {إِن الَّذين كفرُوا ويصدون}: {ويصدون}, which is imperfect, was conjoined to {كفرُوا}, which is past, only because يصدون is in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the past may be a ḥāl together with قد. It is also said that it is conjoined according to the meaning, because its implied form is "those who disbelieve and those who bar" (إن الْكَافرين والصادين). It is said that the wāw is redundant (zāʾida) and يصدون is the khabar of إن. And it is said that the khabar of إن is omitted, its implied form being "those who disbelieved and did such and such have lost and perished", and the like of such implied forms which the speech indicates.
His saying {سَوَاء العاكف فِيهِ والباد}: سَوَاء is nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the resident in it and the visitor are equal" (العاكف والبادي فِيهِ سَوَاء). In this reading there is evidence that the Sanctuary (al-Ḥaram) is not owned, because Allah the Exalted has made the resident and others equal in it. It is also said that {سَوَاء} is nominative as a mubtadaʾ and {العاكف} is nominative by its verbal sense and stands in place of the khabar; and there is remoteness in this, because you would have to make سواء have the meaning of مستو ("equal"), and for that reason it governs; but it is not good for مستو to govern until it leans on something before it. If you make سواء and what follows it in the position of the second object of جعلنا, it becomes good for it to be nominative as a mubtadaʾ and to have the meaning of مستو [Translator's note: the source writes يمعنى for بمعنى], so that you make العاكف nominative by it and it stands in place of the khabar.
Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim read it in the accusative, making it a maṣdar (verbal noun) governed by the meaning of جعلنا, as though He said "We made it equal for the people, an equality" (سويناه للنَّاس سَوَاء), and العاكف is made nominative by it, i.e. with the resident being equal in it. The maṣdar comes with the meaning of the active participle; so سواء, even though it is a maṣdar, has the meaning of مستو, as one says رجل عدل meaning عادل ("just"). On that basis Sībawayh and others permitted مَرَرْت بِرَجُل سَوَاء درهمه ("I passed by a man whose dirham is all the same") and بِرَجُل سَوَاء هُوَ والعدم ("by a man who and nothingness are equal"), i.e. مستو. It is also permissible to make سواء accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied pronoun assumed together with the preposition in
His saying {للنَّاس}, with the adverbial phrase (ẓarf) governing it; or from the hāʾ in {جَعَلْنَاهُ}, with جعلنا governing it. It is also permissible to make it accusative as the second object of جعلنا, and to put {العاكف} in the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of النَّاس or as a badal (substitute). It has been read with العاكف in the genitive as a badal from النَّاس; and it is said: as a naʿt, because النَّاس is a genus among the genera of creatures: "We made it equal for the one resident in it and the visitor".
His saying {وَمن يرد فِيهِ بإلحاد بظُلْم}: the bāʾ in {بإلحاد} is redundant (zāʾida), and the bāʾ in {بظُلْم} is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرد.

mekki-muskil:4-4.t:
His saying {كتب عَلَيْهِ أَنه من تولاه}: أَن is in the position of the nominative by كتب (as nāʾib fāʿil).
And His saying {فَأَنَّهُ يضله}: al-Zajjāj mentioned that the second أن is conjoined to the first, in the position of the nominative. Then he said: as for the fāʾ, the best is that it be in the position of the requital (jazāʾ). Then he went back and undid that, and said: the reality of the second أن is that it is repeated by way of emphasis (tawkīd), because the meaning is "it was written concerning Satan that whoever takes him as a patron, he will lead him astray".
He was criticised for permitting the fāʾ to be conjunctive, because {من تولاه} is a condition and the fāʾ is the answer of the condition, and conjoining to the first أن is not permissible until it is complete, because what follows it belongs to its ṣila; so if it is not complete with its ṣila, conjoining to it is not permissible, since nothing is conjoined to a relative (mawṣūl) until it is complete; and the condition and its answer in this verse are together the khabar of the first أن. He was also criticised for his saying that the second أن is repeated for emphasis; and it was said: how can it be for emphasis when the thing emphasised is not complete? Emphasis is only proper after the thing emphasised is complete, and the first أن is complete at His saying {السعير}.
The correct view on the second أن is that it is in the position of the nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it was written concerning Satan that whoever takes him as a patron, then his affair is that he leads him astray" (فَشَأْنه أَنه يضله), or "then his matter is that he leads him astray", i.e. his affair is leading astray. It is also possible that the second أن is in the position of the nominative by the [implied] being-settled (al-istiqrār), if you imply له, its implied form being "it was written concerning him that whoever takes him as a patron, then for him is that he leads him astray" (فَلهُ أَنه يضله), i.e. for him is his leading him astray and guiding him to the punishment of the Blaze.

mekki-muskil:6-6.t: His saying {ذَلِك بِأَن الله هُوَ الْحق}: ذا is in the position of the nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the matter is that" (الْأَمر ذَلِك). Al-Zajjāj permitted ذا to be in the position of the accusative, in the meaning "Allah did that because He is the Truth" (فعل الله ذَلِك بِأَنَّهُ الْحق).

mekki-muskil:9-9.t: His saying {ثَانِي عطفه}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in يُجَادِل, which refers back to مَن in His saying من يُجَادِل; its meaning is "he disputes about the signs of Allah without knowledge, turning away from the reminder". His saying {ذَلِك بِمَا قدمت}: ذَلِك is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and بما قدمت the khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:26-26.t:
His saying {وَإِذ بوأنا لإِبْرَاهِيم}: the lām entered upon إبراهيم only on the basis that بوأت is taken in the meaning of جعلت ("We made/appointed"), for the basic usage of بوأ is that it does not take its object through a preposition. It is also said that the lām is redundant (zāʾida); and it is said that it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun).
His saying {أَن لَا تشرك}: i.e. بأن لا ("that you should not…"), so it is in the position of the accusative. It is also said that it is redundant for emphasis; and it is said that it has the meaning of أي, for explanation (tafsīr).

mekki-muskil:27-27.t: His saying {وعَلى كل ضامر يَأْتِين}: يأتين (plural) was said only because ضامر has the meaning of a plural and كل indicates generality, so the predicate came according to the meaning, in the plural form. Ibn Masʿūd read يأتون, referring it back to النَّاس.

mekki-muskil:30-30.t: His saying {من الْأَوْثَان}: مِن is for clarifying the genus (bayān al-jins). Al-Akhfash made it partitive (tabʿīḍ), in the meaning "so avoid the filth which is part of the idols". For whoever makes مِن clarify the genus, its meaning is "so avoid the filth of which the idols are [a kind]", and this is more general in the prohibition and more fitting.

mekki-muskil:31-31.t:
His saying {حنفَاء لله}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun in {اجتنبوا}, and likewise {غير مُشْرِكين}.
His saying {فتخطفه الطير}: whoever reads it with the ṭāʾ doubled, its origin for him is فتتخطفه on the pattern تتفعل; then one of the two tāʾs was dropped for lightness because their vowels agree. Whoever reads it light builds it on خطف يخطف, as Allah the Exalted said {إِلَّا من خطف الْخَطفَة}. There are irregular (shādhdh) and well-known readings in it whose explanation would be lengthy.

mekki-muskil:32-32.t: His saying {ذَلِك وَمن يعظم}: ذا is in the position of the nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its meaning being "the matter is that" (الْأَمر ذَلِك); or as a mubtadaʾ in the meaning "that is the matter" (ذَلِك الْأَمر). It is also said that the position of ذا is accusative, in the meaning "follow that of Allah's command" (اتبعُوا ذَلِك من أَمر الله).

mekki-muskil:36-36.t:
His saying {وَالْبدن}: the plural of بَدَن, like وَثَن and وُثْن; the single one is called بَدَن. It is also said that it is the plural of بَدَنة, like خَشَبة and خُشُب, and on this view the second letter may take ḍamma, and Ibn Abī Isḥāq read it so. Quiescence is better, because it is originally an adjective, since it is derived from البدانة (corpulence), and it is not like خشبة and خشب, because this is a noun, so ḍamma in it is better.
His saying {صواف}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), but it is a diptote because it is on the pattern فواعل, so it is a plural which has no counterpart in the singular; it is barred from full declension for these two reasons. Its meaning is "lined up". Al-Ḥasan and others read it صوافيَ with a yāʾ bearing fatḥa, accusative as a ḥāl, and its meaning is "purely for Allah, free of associating partners", so it is derived from الصفاء (purity). Qatāda read it صَوَافِن with nūn; the meaning of الصافنة is the one that has drawn its legs together and raised the tips of its hooves; and it is said that it is the one hobbled with ropes for slaughter. الصافن is a vein at the front of the horse's leg; when it is struck upon, it raises its leg.

mekki-muskil:40-40.t: And His saying {إِلَّا أَن يَقُولُوا}: أَن is in the position of the accusative because it has the meaning of "except because they say" (إلا بِأَن يَقُولُوا).

mekki-muskil:41-41.t: His saying {الَّذين إِن مكناهم}: الَّذين is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from مَن in His saying {ولينصرن الله من ينصره}; and they are Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān and ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with them.

mekki-muskil:45-45.t: His saying {وبئر معطلة}: it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قرية; and it is said to be conjoined to العروش.

mekki-muskil:63-63.t:
His saying {ألم تَرَ أَن الله أنزل من السَّمَاء مَاء فَتُصْبِح الأَرْض مخضرة}: according to Sībawayh and al-Khalīl this speech is a statement (khabar), and the fāʾ is not an answer to His saying {ألم تَرَ}; the meaning according to them is "Take heed, O son of Ādam: Allah sent down water from the sky, and from it such and such came about"; for that reason {فَتُصْبِح} came in the nominative. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is a statement, and its meaning is "Know that Allah sends down water from the sky, and the earth becomes green".
His saying {مِلَّة أبيكم}: ملة is accusative by implying "follow the creed of your father" (اتبعُوا مِلَّة أبيكم). Al-Farrāʾ said: it is accusative by the omission of the preposition, its implied form being "like the creed of your father" (كملة أبيكم); when the preposition was omitted it became accusative. Its implied form according to him is "He has made the religion spacious for you, like the creed of your father", because {وَمَا جعل عَلَيْكُم فِي الدّين من حرج} indicates "He has made it spacious for you". This is a remote view.

mekki-muskil:65-65.t: His saying {أَن تقع على الأَرْض}: أَن is in the position of the accusative in the meaning "out of aversion to its falling", "so that it does not fall", and "for fear of its falling".

mekki-muskil:78-78.t:
His saying {هُوَ سَمَّاكُم الْمُسلمين}: هُوَ refers to Allah (exalted be His mention) according to most of the exegetes; and al-Ḥasan said: it refers to Ibrāhīm (peace be upon him).
And His saying {وَفِي هَذَا}: i.e. "and He named you Muslims in this Qurʾān"; and the pronoun in سماكم likewise admits both views.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿ثم ليقضوا تفثهم وليوفوا نذورهم وليطوفوا بالبيت العتيق﴾: ثم is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يقضوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; تفثهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ليوفوا نذورهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يقضوا تفثهم﴾, and ﴿ليطوفوا بالبيت﴾ is likewise conjoined; بالبيت is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يطوفوا﴾; العتيق is an adjective (ṣifa) of البيت.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter and the affair is that"; it is also said: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "that is the matter which I have mentioned"; and it is also said: in the position of the accusative, its implied form being "comply with that".
﴿ومن يعظم حرمات الله فهو خير له عند ربه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-inducing conditional noun, in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; يعظم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to من; ﴿حرمات﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and خير its khabar; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير. The clause ﴿فهو خير﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of من. عند ربه: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and ربه is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأحلت لكم الأنعام إلا ما يتلى عليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أحلت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحلت﴾; الأنعام is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلا is a particle of exception; ما is the excepted, in which both the connected and the disconnected (exception) are permissible: disconnected on the basis that what was mentioned in the verse of al-Māʾida is not of the genus of livestock, such as blood and the flesh of swine; and connected on the basis of referring it to such livestock as become forbidden through an incidental cause, such as death and the like. The clause يتلى is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتلى﴾.
﴿فاجتنبوا الرجس من الأوثان واجتنبوا قول الزور﴾: the fāʾ is a consequence drawn from His saying ﴿ومن يعظم حرمات الله﴾; اجتنبوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; الرجس is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الأوثان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and it is also said: tamyīz (specification). واجتنبوا: the wāw is a conjunction, اجتنبوا is an imperative verb and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; قول الزور is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿اجتنبوا قول الزور﴾ is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿حنفاء لله غير مشركين به﴾: حنفاء لله is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of اجتنبوا, and غير مشركين is likewise an emphasising ḥāl from it; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مشركين.
﴿ومن يشرك بالله فكأنما خر من السماء فتخطفه الطير أو تهوي به الريح في مكان سحيق﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. من is a jussive-inducing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يشرك بالله﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). فكأنما: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; كأنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; خر is a past verb with a latent fāʿil (agent); من السماء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خر﴾; فتخطفه is conjoined to خر, and الطير is the fāʿil. ﴿أو تهوي به الريح﴾: likewise conjoined; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تهوي﴾; في مكان is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿تهوي﴾; سحيق is a naʿt (adjective) of مكان.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter and the affair is that"; it is also said: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "that is the matter which I have mentioned"; and it is also said: in the position of the accusative, its implied form being "comply with that".
﴿ومن يعظم شعائر الله فإنها من تقوى القلوب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-inducing conditional noun, in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; يعظم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to من; ﴿شعائر﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ. وإنها: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun; ﴿من تقوى القلوب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿لكم فيها منافع إلى أجل مسمى ثم محلها إلى البيت العتيق﴾: لكم is a fronted khabar (predicate); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); منافع is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلى أجل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of منافع; مسمى is an adjective of أجل. ثم is a conjunction; محلها is a mubtadaʾ; إلى البيت is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; العتيق is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولكل أمة جعلنا منسكا ليذكروا اسم الله على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿لكل أمة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted second object of جعلنا; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); منسكًا is the first object of جعلنا; the clause ﴿ولكل أمة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ليذكروا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation; يذكروا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعلنا﴾. ﴿اسم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿على ما رزقهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يذكروا﴾; the clause رزقهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رزقهم﴾.
﴿فإلهكم إله واحد فله أسلموا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); ﴿إلهكم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿إله﴾ its khabar (predicate), and واحد an adjective (ṣifa). فله: the fāʾ is a conjunction; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسلموا﴾. اسلموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source spells it «اسلموا» without the hamza; the ayah has «أسلموا».]
﴿وبشر المخبتين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; بشر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; المخبتين is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿الذين إذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم والصابرين على ما أصابهم والمقيمي الصلاة ومما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of المخبتين or a badal (substitute) from it. إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis; the clause ﴿ذكر الله﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the clause ﴿وجلت قلوبهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; إذا with its verb and its apodosis has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. الصابرين is conjoined to الذين; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الصابرين﴾; the clause أصابهم is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. المقيمي الصلاة is likewise conjoined, the nūn having been dropped because of the annexation. مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفقون﴾; the clause رزقناهم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿مما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿والبدن جعلناها لكم من شعائر الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; البدن is the object of an omitted verb, so it is accusative by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), i.e. "and We made the sacrificial camels"; جعلناها is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعلناها﴾; ﴿من شعائر الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted second object of ﴿جعلناها﴾, which is in the sense of "making into".
﴿لكم فيها خير﴾: لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); خير is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl from the hāʾ in جعلناها.
﴿فاذكروا اسم الله عليها صواف﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿اسم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اذكروا﴾; صواف is a ḥāl from the hāʾ in عليها.
﴿فإذا وجبت جنوبها فكلوا منها وأطعموا القانع والمعتر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is a future adverb, and the clause وجبت جنوبها is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it. فكلوا: the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; the clause كلوا منها has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. وأطعموا القانع والمعتر: conjoined to the clause كلوا منها; أطعموا is a verb and its fāʿil; القانع is the mafʿūl bihi; and المعتر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to القانع.
﴿كذلك سخرناها لكم لعلكم تشكرون﴾: كذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "He subjected them with a subjection like that subjection" [Translator's note: so in the source, «سخرها»; the ayah here has «سخرناها» (We subjected them); the wording seems carried over from the next ayah]; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿سخرناها﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is a ḥāl; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سخرناها﴾. لعلكم: لعل is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; the clause تشكرون is the khabar of لعل, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the kāf in ﴿لكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقوى منكم﴾: لن: a particle of negation, of the accusative and of the future; ينال: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لحومها is the fāʿil (agent) of ينال; ولا دماؤها is conjoined to لحومها. ولكن: the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative because it is lightened; يناله is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; التقوى is the fāʿil; منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from التقوى.
﴿كذلك سخرها لكم لتكبروا الله على ما هداكم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "He subjected them with a subjection like that subjection"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. سخرها is a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخرها﴾. لتكبروا: the lām is the lām of causation; تكبروا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the lām and what falls within its scope, a preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to ﴿سخرها﴾. The Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; على is a preposition, and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. "for His guiding you", or relative, i.e. "for that to which He has guided you"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تكبروا﴾ because it is made to include the meaning of thanking.
﴿وبشر المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; بشر: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; المحسنين is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿إن الله يدافع عن الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause يدافع is the khabar of إن; عن الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدافع﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يدافع is omitted, its implied form being "the aggressions of the polytheists and their calamities".
﴿إن الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور﴾: a causal explanation of the preceding clause. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause لا يحب is its khabar; كل خوان is the mafʿūl bihi; and كفور is an adjective (ṣifa) of خوان.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿أذن للذين يقاتلون بأنهم ظلموا﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. أذن: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); what permission is given for is omitted because it is known, i.e. "permission is given to those who are fought, to fight". للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أذن﴾; the clause يقاتلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; يقاتلون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). بأنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿أذن﴾, the bāʾ being causal, i.e. "because of their being wronged". أنهم: أن and its noun, and the clause ظلموا is the khabar (predicate) of أنهم.
﴿وإن الله على نصرهم لقدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive. وإن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); قدير is the khabar of إن; على نصرهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿الذين أخرجوا من ديارهم بغير حق إلا أن يقولوا ربنا الله﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of, or a badal (substitute) from, ﴿الذين يقاتلون﴾, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause أخرجوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the wāw in ﴿أخرجوا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرجوا﴾; بغير حق is a ḥāl (circumstantial). إلا is a particle of exception, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن يقولوا﴾ is a disconnected excepted, accusative (manṣūb). It is also said: the exception is mufarragh (with the excepted-from left unexpressed), because of the presence of negation through غير, and ﴿أن يقولوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a badal from حق. ربنا is a mubtadaʾ and الله a khabar, and the clause ﴿ربنا الله﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صوامع وبيع وصلوات ومساجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence, containing the meaning of condition; دفع الله is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is necessarily omitted; الناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of دفع, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) annexed to its fāʿil (agent), which is Allah; بعضهم is a badal of part (badal baʿḍ) from الناس; ببعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿دفع﴾. The lām occurs in the apodosis of لولا; هدمت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); صوامع is the nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿وبيع وصلوات ومساجد﴾ is conjoined to صوامع; the clause يذكر is an adjective (ṣifa) of the places mentioned; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذكر﴾; اسم الله is the nāʾib fāʿil; كثيرا is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "much remembrance", or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "much time".
﴿ولينصرن الله من ينصره﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The lām occurs in the response to an oath; ينصرن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil; من is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ينصره is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله لقوي عزيز﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); قوي is the first khabar of إن, and عزيز the second khabar of إن; the clause of إن and what follows it gives the cause of the help.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿الذين إن مكناهم في الأرض أقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وأمروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر﴾: الذين is a badal (substitute) from the preceding الذين; إن is conditional; مكناهم is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكناهم﴾; أقاموا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi; and what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿ولله عاقبة الأمور﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; لله is a fronted khabar (predicate), and عاقبة الأمور a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وإن يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; يكذبوك is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). فقد: the fāʾ links the apodosis because it is joined to ﴿قد﴾; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كذبت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the clause ﴿فقد كذبت﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قبلهم is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; قوم نوح is the fāʿil; and عاد وثمود: conjoined to قوم نوح.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وقوم إبراهيم﴾: conjoined to قوم نوح; the wāw is a conjunction, قوم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) and nominative (marfūʿ), and إبراهيم is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وقوم لوط﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of وقوم إبراهيم.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وأصحاب مدين وكذب موسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أصحاب مدين is conjoined to قوم نوح; كذب is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and موسى is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فأمليت للكافرين ثم أخذتهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أمليت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمليت﴾; ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; أخذتهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فكيف كان نكير﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar of كان; نكير is the noun of كان.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فكأين من قرية أهلكناها وهي ظالمة فهي خاوية على عروشها وبئر معطلة وقصر مشيد﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; كأين is declarative (khabariyya, "how many"), and its position is the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); من قرية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted tamyīz (specification) of كأين; the clause أهلكناها, made up of the verb, the fāʿil (agent) and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is the khabar (predicate) of كأين. ﴿وهي ظالمة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هي is a mubtadaʾ and ظالمة a khabar. The clause ﴿فكأين من قرية...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وهي ظالمة﴾ is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). فهي: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هي is a mubtadaʾ and خاوية a khabar; the clause ﴿فهي خاوية﴾ is conjoined to the clause أهلكناها. على عروشها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خاوية﴾, the meaning being: fallen down upon their roofs, in that the roof fell first and then the walls collapsed upon it; or attached to an omitted second khabar of ﴿هي﴾, the meaning being: empty of their people, standing upon their roofs. بئر is conjoined to قرية, i.e. "and how many a well"; معطلة is an adjective (ṣifa) of بئر; قصر is likewise conjoined; and مشيد is an adjective of قصر.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿أفلم يسيروا في الأرض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها أو آذان يسمعون بها﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. لم is a particle of negation, of inversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يسيروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسيروا﴾. ﴿فتكون﴾: the fāʾ is causal, and ﴿تكون﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal fāʾ; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿تكون﴾; قلوب is its postponed noun; the clause يعقلون is an adjective (ṣifa) of قلوب; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعقلون﴾; أو is a conjunction; آذان is conjoined to قلوب; and the clause ﴿يسمعون بها﴾ is an adjective of آذان.
﴿فإنها لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب التي في الصدور﴾: the fāʾ is for causation; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿ها﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا تعمى الأبصار﴾ is the khabar. ولكن: the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), made inoperative because it is lightened; ﴿تعمى القلوب﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; التي is an adjective of القلوب; في الصدور is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يستعجلونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستعجلونك﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; لن is a particle of negation and of the future; يخلف is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil; and وعده is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وإن يوما عند ربك كألف سنة مما تعدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); يوما is the noun of إن; ﴿عند ربك﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿كألف﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿ألف﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿سنة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of سنة; and the clause ﴿تعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وكأين من قرية أمليت لها وهي ظالمة ثم أخذتها وإلي المصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كأين is declarative (khabariyya, "how many"), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); من قرية is in the position of the accusative as the tamyīz (specification) of كأين; the clause ﴿أمليت لها﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of قرية. ﴿وهي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ظالمة a khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿وهي ظالمة﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ثم is a conjunction; أخذتها is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أخذتها﴾ is conjoined to أمليت. وإليَّ: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; ﴿إليَّ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; and المصير is a postponed mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: the source names no khabar for كأين here.]

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قل يا أيها الناس إنما أنا لكم نذير مبين﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed, a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting; الناس is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نذير; نذير is the khabar (predicate); and مبين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم﴾: the fāʾ is for drawing a consequence (tafrīʿ); الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; عملوا is conjoined to آمنوا; الصالحات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مغفرة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; رزق is conjoined to مغفرة; كريم is an adjective (ṣifa) of رزق; and the clause ﴿لهم مغفرة﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿والذين سعوا في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause سعوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; في آياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سعوا﴾; معاجزين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أولئك is a second mubtadaʾ, and أصحاب الجحيم the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي إلا إذا تمنى ألقى الشيطان في أمنيته﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ما is negating; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). من قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾, and من is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya). من رسول: من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and رسول is genitive in form and accusative in position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرسلنا﴾. ولا نبي: conjoined to من رسول. إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); إذا is a future adverb, and the clause ﴿تمنى﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the clause ﴿ألقى الشيطان﴾ has no grammatical position; and the conditional clause is in the position of the accusative as a disconnected exception. في أمنيته is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقى﴾.
﴿فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطان ثم يحكم الله آياته﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ينسخ الله is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يلقي الشيطان﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فينسخ الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction; يحكم الله is a verb and its fāʿil; and آياته is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عليم: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; حكيم: a second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطان فتنة للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسية قلوبهم﴾: the lām is for causation, and the verb after it is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يُحْكِمُ﴾, i.e. "then Allah makes His signs firm, in order to make…", or attached to ﴿ينسخ﴾. ﴿ما﴾ is relative or maṣdariyya, and it is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يلقي الشيطان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of فتنة; ﴿في قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مرض is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; القاسية: conjoined to الذين; and قلوبهم is the fāʿil (agent) of القاسية.
﴿وإن الظالمين لفي شقاق بعيد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and الظالمين is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في شقاق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن; بعيد is an adjective of شقاق; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وليعلم الذين أوتوا العلم أنه الحق من ربك فيؤمنوا به فتخبت له قلوبهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليعلم is conjoined to ليجعل; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوتوا العلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; العلم is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أوتوا; ﴿أنه الحق﴾ takes the place of the two objects of يعلم; من ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) [Translator's note: so in the source, «من ربهم»; the ayah has «من ربك»]. فيؤمنوا: conjoined to يعلم; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾. فتخبت: conjoined to فيؤمنوا; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخبت﴾; and قلوبهم is the fāʿil.
﴿وإن الله لهاد الذين آمنوا إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun. لهاد: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هاد is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذين is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, by way of the annexation of the active participle to its object, since it is an active participle; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and إلى صراط مستقيم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هاد﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مرية منه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا يزال is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters); الذين كفروا is its noun; في مرية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مرية.
﴿حتى تأتيهم الساعة بغتة أو يأتيهم عذاب يوم عقيم﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; تأتيهم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the "being settled" (istiqrār) to which ﴿في مرية﴾ is attached. الساعة is the fāʿil (agent); بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أو is a conjunction; يأتيهم is conjoined to تأتيهم; ﴿عذاب يوم﴾ is the fāʿil; and عقيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿الملك يومئذ لله يحكم بينهم﴾: الملك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) to which ﴿لله﴾ is attached; إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being "on the day when the Hour or the punishment comes to them". ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يحكم بينهم﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; and ﴿بينهم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات في جنات النعيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the clause آمنوا; ﴿في جنات النعيم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا فأولئك لهم عذاب مهين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿كذبوا بآياتنا﴾ is conjoined to the clause كفروا. فأولئك: the fāʾ is linking, because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; مهين is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿لهم عذاب مهين﴾ is the khabar of أولئك; and the clause ﴿فأولئك لهم عذاب مهين﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا أو ماتوا ليرزقنهم الله رزقا حسنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هاجروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿هاجروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun plus a muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هاجروا﴾. ثم is a conjunction; قُتِلُوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿قتلوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause هاجروا. أو is a conjunction; ماتوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿ماتوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause قتلوا. ليرزقنهم: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; يرزقنهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil; رزقًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); حسنًا is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿ليرزقنهم الله ...﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿وإن الله لهو خير الرازقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar of هو; الرازقين is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿هو خير الرازقين﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; يدخلنهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يدخلنهم﴾ is the response to the oath; مدخلا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a mīmī maṣdar, or an adverb of place; and the clause ﴿يرضونه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of مدخلا.
﴿وإن الله لعليم حليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); عليم is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and حليم a second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter is that".
﴿ومن عاقب بمثل ما عوقب به ثم بغي عليه لينصرنه الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; عاقب is a past verb; بمثل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاقب﴾; ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; عوقب is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عوقب﴾; the clause ﴿عوقب به﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction; بغى is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿بغي عليه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿عاقب﴾. لينصرنه: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; ينصرنه is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil (agent); and the oath clause is the khabar of مَن.
﴿إن الله لعفو غفور﴾: a causal clause with no grammatical position. ﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); عفو is the khabar of إن, and غفور a second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿ذلك بأن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل وأن الله سميع بصير﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). بأن الله: the bāʾ is a causal preposition; أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن. يولج الليل: a verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في النهار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يولج﴾. The clause ﴿بأن الله ...﴾ etc., made up of the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾. ويولج النهار في الليل: conjoined to the clause ﴿يولج الليل﴾. وأن الله: أن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; سميع is the khabar of أن, and بصير a second khabar of أن; and the clause ﴿أن الله سميع بصير﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بأن الله ...﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله هو الحق﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). بأن الله: the bāʾ is a causal preposition. أن الله: أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and الحق the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن; or: هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and what follows it is the khabar of أن. The clause ﴿بأن الله هو الحق﴾, made up of the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ذلك.
